# Sre Practice Lead Skill

> **Category:** Domain Skills

## Overview

Use when implementing SRE practices including SLO definition, error budget management, reliability reviews, and chaos engineering for new projects.

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [sre-practice-lead-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
sre-practice-lead-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@sre-practice-lead` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Analyze cloud spending across services, teams, and environments
- Identify cost optimization opportunities: idle resources, over-provisioning, licensing waste
- Model ROI scenarios for technology investments and migrations
- Track budget utilization with alerting on threshold breaches

## Industry Standards Applied

- **ITIL v4**: IT service management: incident, problem, change management
- **SRE Principles (Google)**: SLO/SLI, error budgets, toil reduction, blameless postmortems
- **ISO 20000**: IT service management system requirements
